collector.units: bytes requested in successful allocator operations; allocator metadata, size-class rounding, page retention, native library allocations, and RSS excluded
collector.process_model: one mode and entry per new process; frontend construction and every selective drop run on the same thread
collector.tracking_interval: continuous begin_stage before entry read/load/parse until every owned frontend or prepared object is dropped; no end_stage between construction and drops
collector.untracked_owned_values: CLI argument storage is created before tracking and retained beyond end_stage; it cannot be freed inside the measured interval
collector.snapshot_storage: fixed inline array; no formatting, JSON generation, printing, or allocating result storage between live snapshots
collector.allocation_traffic: mem_track alloc_count counts alloc/alloc_zeroed and growing realloc events; alloc_bytes counts allocation requests and growing realloc deltas, rather than the entire replacement block on realloc
collector.rss: collected separately from unmodified production binaries; these heap request bytes are never substituted for process RSS

roots: complete CheckOutput, including all maps, sets, annotations, diagnostics, prepared constants, call facts, effects, requirements, projections, and inferred binding/parameter/return facts
complete CompactDeclOutput, including all declaration maps, qualified maps, schema/default/constant/wire-enum/CLI preparation, diagnostics, and checked consumer views
complete CompactBodyProbeOutput, including all expression/block/stage/handler types, requirements, projections, diagnostics, and classification sets
retained_fact_contract.bytes: exact decrease in allocator live request bytes across root destruction when allocation traffic is unchanged; otherwise unavailable/null
retained_fact_contract.owner_context: parsed arena, source map, and an explicit SymbolOwner clone stay alive until all fact roots have been destroyed
retained_fact_contract.inline_storage: size_of of each materialized output value reported separately once; never added per recursively visited Type or boxed root; inline bytes excluded from mandatory heap comparison
retained_fact_contract.shared_storage: counted once in combined union when its last fact owner is dropped; opposite drop orders expose storage held by the other fact view
retained_fact_contract.scope: whole finalized frontend output owner retention, including non-type fields; no unsupported claim that only exact typing nodes were isolated
retained_fact_contract.candidate_policy: repeat identical source/load/options/lifetime modes against candidate libxsh; include every candidate finalized solved graph/interface pool owner in the root set before freezing candidate measurements; do not leave a solved graph outside the drop roots and call it source/environment
retained_fact_contract.environment_exclusions: source, arena/CST/token data and symbol interner ownership remain separately visible in later teardown snapshots; their allocations are not recursively charged to every referring fact

modes.full: normal parse/load/full check, followed by full CheckOutput destruction with parsed/source/symbol owners retained
modes.compact: normal parse/load/full check records baseline status; discard full output before materializing compact declarations and body views, then destroy both compact roots
modes.combined-full-first: retain normal full CheckOutput and both compact outputs together; destroy full, body, declaration roots in that order
modes.combined-compact-first: retain the same three roots; destroy body, declaration, full roots in that order
modes.prepared: prepare_benchmark_script returns an opaque fully prepared script after the runner has released frontend state; drop it without running any user instruction
modes.prepared-symbol-context: extra parse/load retains only its SymbolOwner through prepared artifact destruction; prepared-only names may still cause cleanup allocations; construction traffic includes extra parse and cannot measure ordinary cold startup

comparison.mandatory_compatibility_bytes: fact_union_heap_bytes from combined-full-first, validated against combined-compact-first; all finalized typing/interface roots and duplicated consumer views included
comparison.independent_outputs: full and compact mode fact_union_heap_bytes; these separate constructions are not blindly summed because the combined construction may share backing storage
comparison.shared_lifetime_check: compare full_drop_heap_bytes and compact_drop_heap_bytes across opposite combined drop orders; each pair must sum to that run's unique union
comparison.observation_check: All fact modes match in parse/full checker status, expression fact count, source closure count/bytes, and unchanged diagnostic fingerprint. Reference rows independently compare unmodified baseline xsht check exit status and uninstrumented ordinary verified-preparation probe status. Future final cohort collection must retain the same observation checks.
comparison.diagnostic_fingerprint: DefaultHasher over unchanged diagnostic messages/codes/spans/severities and labels, computed without formatting; toolchain-local consistency fingerprint, not a source identity hash
comparison.invalid_collection: nonzero helper exit, missing JSON, absent tracking, drop-time allocation, changed baseline status, or inconsistent opposite-order union is a collection failure; absent counters never become zero

reconciliation.facts_finalized_live_bytes: independent live snapshot before any fact root destruction
reconciliation.fact_drop_delta: observed union owner destruction, not a recursive type or map-capacity estimate
reconciliation.parsed_source_symbol_deltas: separate observed owner teardown net live differences; signed because symbol release may allocate reusable interner capacity
reconciliation.final_external_residual_live_bytes: observed allocations still live after every explicitly owned object is gone; process globals/interner reusable capacity remain disclosed rather than forced to zero
reconciliation.equation: facts-finalized live = observed fact drop + observed parsed drop + observed source drop + observed symbol-owner drop + observed final external residual
reconciliation.raw_evidence: all boundary snapshots include live bytes, peak bytes, allocation event count, and requested allocation traffic so reconciliation is auditable

prepared_after_frontend_drop.bytes: exact opaque prepared-owner drop delta on successful preparation; includes evaluator, indexed store, execution plan, environment/source/symbol ownership and retained RunOptions
prepared_after_frontend_drop.execution: none; owner is destroyed before run
prepared_after_frontend_drop.unavailable_reason: public prepared-script facade does not expose the encapsulated evaluator or independently attributable pool owners; no internal source instrumentation was added
prepared_after_frontend_drop.cleanup_traffic: prepared_drop_net_heap_bytes is the signed observed live decrease; prepared_drop_alloc_count/bytes disclose destruction-time traffic; exact owner-only bytes remain null when that traffic is nonzero
prepared_after_frontend_drop.symbol_context: prepared-symbol-context holds parsed names externally until after artifact drop; exact bytes exclude externally owned symbols and interner storage; preparation-only symbols can still require cleanup allocation

work_counters.reason: baseline does not expose mutable solver work counters through this collector
